messages:
mike: Deploy to prod finished for slice-a at 18:07 UTC. Can folks run a quick smoke checklist in the next 10m? Quick items: 1) /health on web+api, 2) p50/p95 latency from realtime, 3) sample gen sanity (short prompt), 4) inference-gw error rate. Commands to run locally: ```curl -sS https://api.prod.redwood.ai/health && curl -sS -X POST https://api.prod.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{\"prompt\":\"small test\"}'``` Tag me and @oncall if you see anything abnormal.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout complete for slice-a -> 100% stable. No CI errors reported. :white_check_mark:

jia: ran /health -> all services green. did sample gen, 200 but output is shorter than usual for this test prompt (noted). p50 ~35ms, p95 ~120ms, error rate 0.02% (within baseline).

anna: seeing a tail latency spike on node-gpu-12, p95 ~280ms and CPU load at 78%. digging into logs now.

pranav: logs show a few "model load slow" warnings on node-gpu-12 right after canary promotion — could be cold KV/cache. I can rollback slice if needed, but suggest we try priming first. Rollback command if we need it: `deploy rollback --slice slice-a --to 2026-03-17T17:50`.

mike: ok hold on rollback. anna, can you trigger a cache priming job on that node first? Command: `kubectl exec -c priming -it priming-job -- /app/prime --keys 100`.

anna: priming started on node-gpu-12. will post when priming completes. ETA ~90s.

sam: tagging logs for post-deploy window for easier correlation: `log query --service=inference --from=18:00 --to=18:10 --tag=postdeploy-slice-a`.

olivia: ran a tiny eval (10 prompts) against the new model. outputs look fine overall, 1/10 had a formatting regression (missing trailing newline). Not blocking, but I'll document and add to regression test set. :ok_hand:

pranav: priming finished, rechecked node-gpu-12: p95 down to ~130ms, warnings cleared. Warmup appears to be the root cause. No rollback needed. :relieved:

mike: great. anna, keep that node under 10m watch and post final metrics, then we can close this out.

deploy-bot: Automated snapshot: errors 0.01%, avg tokens/sec within expected bounds, no new alerts.

anna: 10m watch complete, no further anomalies. marking slice-a healthy. :white_check_mark:

mike: thanks everyone. i'll open a short follow-up doc for the formatting regression and add the new prompt to the eval set. closing this thread."
